semiconductor_relevance: High — Nanosurf specializes in atomic force microscopy (AFM) systems that are critical for inspection and measurement in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Nanosurf AG designs and develops custom atomic force microscopes tailored for specific industrial applications, enhancing measurement precision and efficiency in semiconductor production. Their solutions integrate seamlessly into existing manufacturing processes, addressing unique challenges faced by clients in the semiconductor sector.
capabilities: Integration of AFM into production lines

regional_presence.Europe: Nanosurf is based in Switzerland and serves clients across Europe.
